& Mercury, Tuesday, May 26, 1931

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
C. & S. M. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2461.
Date 2 - 6 - 31.

Group Comes Here
To Study Mission
Work In Far East

Fact-Finding Party Will
Stay In Shanghai
Whole Month

PLAN FULL PROBE
OF CHURCH NEEDS

Religious Investigation
Will Cover India,
China, Japan

Experts from the New York Institute of Social and Religious Research, who for the past seven months have been conducting a study of missionary conditions in China, India and Japan at the request of the Laymen's Foreign Missions Inquiry, arrived in Shanghai yesterday for a month's stay.

Members of the China staff here to continue their fact-finding investigation include Mr. H. Paul Douglass, D.D.; Mr. W. A. Anderson, Ph.D.; Miss Josephine E. Budd, M.A.; Mr. Robert W. Bruere, M.A.; Mr. Stanley Ross Fisher, D.D.; Mr. William G. Lennox, M.D.; Mr. Edson W. Knight, Ph.D.; Mr. T. H. P. Sailer, Ph.D.; Mr. Guy W. Sarvis, M.A., and Miss Anna Seesholtz, M.A.

Work In Japan, India

These men and women, all experts in various educational, religious, medical, sociological or commercial fields, are working under the leadership of Mr. Galen M. Fisher, general director of the fact-finding commission. They have been studying the missionary work and problems of the American mission boards in China, while similar committees have been working in a like manner in Japan and India.

《水星报》，1931年5月26日，星期二

上海工部局
C. & S. M. 登记处
编号：S. B. D. 2461。
日期：31年6月2日。

团体来此
考察远东
传教工作

实况调查团将
在上海停留
整整一个月

计划全面调查
教会需求

宗教调查
将涵盖印度、
中国、日本

应平信徒海外传教调查委员会（Laymen's Foreign Missions Inquiry）之请，来自纽约社会与宗教研究所的专家们在过去七个月里一直对中国、印度和日本的传教状况进行研究，他们于昨日抵达上海，将停留一个月。

在华继续开展实况调查的中方工作人员包括：H. Paul Douglass 神学博士；W. A. Anderson 哲学博士；Josephine E. Budd 文学硕士；Robert W. Bruere 文学硕士；Stanley Ross Fisher 神学博士；William G. Lennox 医学博士；Edson W. Knight 哲学博士；T. H. P. Sailer 哲学博士；Guy W. Sarvis 文学硕士，以及 Anna Seesholtz 文学硕士。

在日本、印度的工作

这些男女专家均在教育、宗教、医学、社会学或商业等不同领域具备专长，他们在实况调查委员会总干事 Galen M. Fisher 先生的领导下开展工作。他们一直在研究美国各差会董事会在中国的传教工作及面临的问题，而类似的委员会也在日本和印度以同样的方式开展工作。
